name: Fathom
one_liner: Fathom is a meeting recording and AI insights platform that offers a public API and MCP server for integrating meeting data with LLMs.
auth_notes: API keys are created at the user level and can be set via the environment variable FATHOM_API_KEY_AUTH.
access_notes: Rate limiting is 60 calls per minute across all API keys, indicating a free self-serve model.

extras.rate_limits: Rate Limiting: users can make 60 calls per minute across all of their API keys; this ensures system stability and reliability.

evidence.snippet: Partners can register an OAuth app to be eligible for a future marketplace listing as a Fathom‑approved integration.
